bear.last: MSTR: While MSTR sits well below its 20‑day ($111.44), 50‑day ($135.87) and 200‑day ($130.93) SMAs and has posted a brutal 45.7% drop over the last 20 days, the stock is also deeply oversold (RSI 25.9) and hovering near its 20‑day low ($77.32) and 52‑week low ($70.37), which often precedes a technical bounce. Moreover, implied volatility is sky‑high at 89.2% with a 6.49% 2‑day move expectation, meaning the next price swing could be upward as much as the downside scenario the short trade assumes. All of these factors make the short thesis vulnerable to a swift reversal despite the bearish technical picture.
